name: DriveCar_1
short_caption: The robot mimics driving a car, turning an imaginary steering wheel left and right.
movement_description: The robot starts by bringing both hands up in front of its chest, holding an imaginary steering wheel and looking to the left. It then rotates its hands as if turning the wheel to the right, shifting its gaze and head direction accordingly. Next, it raises its right hand to gesture outward, returns to holding the wheel, and then raises its left hand in a waving or pointing gesture before returning to a neutral rest position.
safety_notes: The robot sweeps its arms outward and upward during the driving mimicry; ensure a clear envelope of at least 50 cm around the upper body.
